reference: Baitly specialized AI agent concept sheet
delivery: 256x256 WebP resting portraits, quality 94, alpha preserved; poster matches the motion's first frame
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE square production UI asset from the reference sheet, ONLY the specified character. Preserve this exact Baitly AI agent's character design, costume, equipment and soft photographic 3D materials. Keep entire head, torso, both hands and professional props fully visible, isolated and centered within a square with 8% empty margin on all sides. No other characters. Remove all captions and all text. Actual transparent RGBA background with clean antialiased alpha, no floor or shadow outside the character, no fake checkerboard or solid backdrop. Output a single 512x512 cutout. The navy/ivory/brass specialist must be immediately recognizable in a small 64px circular UI node. Do not add any new details, logos, glow or decoration.

assets.gesture: With its right hand the agent brings its existing megaphone up toward its face and addresses it as if speaking, then lowers it back. The other hand keeps its brass growth arrow. The megaphone is ALWAYS held with the same hand.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make one production ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of this exact Baitly AI specialist. The input cutout is the identity and costume reference. Keep its face, clothing, colors, physical hands and tools exactly consistent. With its right hand the agent brings its existing megaphone up toward its face and addresses it as if speaking, then lowers it back. The other hand keeps its brass growth arrow. The megaphone is ALWAYS held with the same hand.
REQUIRED OUTPUT: transparent PNG, 2048px wide by 1024px high. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal 512x512 cells, edge-to-edge grid with NO gutters, NO labels, NO borders, NO background or floor. Each cell contains the SAME complete character at the SAME camera distance, same scale, same centered head and fixed body location, with 10% transparent margins. Never cross cell edges. Only its arms, hands, props and eyelids change between cells; the head must not drift or rescale. Genuine transparent alpha background. Render all eight separate full frames.
Frame order is left to right top row then left to right bottom row. Frame 1: original rest pose, eyes open. Frame 2: same rest pose, BOTH eyes CLOSED as two thin curved pale eyelid slits. Frame 3: eyes open, begin the described hand/tool gesture. Frame 4: eyes open, half-way to the action pose. Frame 5: action pose at its peak, eyes open. Frame 6: same peak action pose, BOTH eyes closed in a natural blink. Frame 7: eyes open, arms/props half-way returning to rest. Frame 8: return EXACTLY to frame 1 rest pose, eyes open. A readable sequence with clear physical movement of the held equipment, not eight identical figures. No motion blur, no speed lines, no effects. Premium photographic 3D materials, navy, warm ivory and brass, consistent soft studio lighting, no captions or text.
